title: AI Conformance Manifest (ACM) v1
description: Machine-readable, signed expression of a domain's AI-disclosure posture, content map, and provenance. Article 50's disclosure obligation is human-facing; this manifest is value-add governance and forward infrastructure, NOT itself a legal requirement. The signature is computed over the JCS (RFC 8785) canonicalization of the manifest with provenance.signature, provenance.anchor and provenance.content_id removed. See spec/signing.

issued_at.description: When this manifest version was generated and signed.

expires_at.description: Freshness boundary. Past this time a fetcher should treat the manifest as stale and re-fetch.

content_source.description: Provenance of the content map. 'managed-crawl' is the explicitly-degraded fallback and MUST be surfaced to consumers as lower fidelity.

issuer.description: Identity of the domain owner / manifest issuer.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 country/region of the operating entity.

ai_disclosure.description: The Article 50-aligned disclosure block: the AI systems operating on the site.

summary.description: Plain-language overview of AI use on the site.

consent.description: Reference to the consent configuration the site's cookie/consent banner renders, so the human banner and this machine manifest read the same source.

config_ref.description: Canonical reference to the consent configuration.

categories.description: Declared consent categories (e.g. necessary, analytics, marketing).

framework.description: Consent framework in use, if any (e.g. TCF).

content_map.description: Structured map of the public content surface. The source for llms.txt / llms-full.txt / per-page .md renderings.

sections.description: Ordered, named groupings used to build the curated llms.txt index.

verification.description: How a third party can verify this manifest.

provenance.description: Signing and anchoring envelope. 'signature', 'anchor' and 'content_id' are EXCLUDED from the canonicalized payload that 'signature' signs; every other member is signed.

public_key.description: Base64url-encoded raw Ed25519 public key (the JWK 'x' value). Optional: omit in favour of key_ref + a JWKS.

key_ref.description: Identifier of the signing key (kid): the RFC 7638 thumbprint of the Ed25519 public key, or a JWKS kid.

content_id.description: Content address of the signing payload: 'ispk_' + base64url(SHA-256(JCS(payload))). Verifiers recompute it before checking the signature.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature over the JCS-canonicalized payload excluding provenance.signature and provenance.anchor.

anchor.description: Optional timestamp anchor from a third-party attestation service. Added AFTER signing; absent until then. The manifest is valid and verifiable from signed_at regardless of anchor state.

attestation_id.description: Identifier of the attestation at the anchoring service.

txid.description: Transaction id of the anchor, if the service anchors to a public ledger.

merkle_proof_ref.description: Where the inclusion proof can be retrieved.

synthetic_media.description: True if the system generates or manipulates image, audio, or video content that should be marked as artificially generated (Article 50 transparency).

purpose.description: What the system does on the site.

user_facing_disclosure.description: The exact plain-language disclosure shown to humans for this system. Must mirror what the site shows.

human_oversight.description: Nature of human oversight, if any.

data_handling.description: Summary of data the system processes.

high_risk.description: Whether the operator considers this a high-risk use under the EU AI Act. Self-declared; not a legal determination.

priority.description: Higher = more prominent in the curated index.

md_url.description: URL of the per-page markdown rendering.

content_hash.description: Hash of the canonical markdown for this page.
